segments.mn113:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn113:2.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn113:2.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn113:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso uccākulā pabbajito hoti.
segments.mn113:3.4: ‘ahaṃ khomhi uccākulā pabbajito, ime panaññe bhikkhū na uccākulā pabbajitā’ti.
segments.mn113:3.5: So tāya uccākulīnatāya attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:3.7: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:3.8: ‘na kho uccākulīnatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
segments.mn113:3.10: so ca hoti dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso’ti.
segments.mn113:3.11: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya uccākulīnatāya nevattānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:4-6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso mahākulā pabbajito hoti … pe …[yathā uccākulavāre tathā vitthāretabbaṃ] mahābhogakulā pabbajito hoti … pe … uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito hoti.
segments.mn113:4-6.5: ‘ahaṃ khomhi uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito, ime panaññe bhikkhū na uḷārabhogakulā pabbajitā’ti.
segments.mn113:4-6.6: So tāya uḷārabhogatāya attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:4-6.8: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:4-6.9: ‘na kho uḷārabhogatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
segments.mn113:4-6.11: so ca hoti dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso’ti.
segments.mn113:4-6.12: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya uḷārabhogatāya nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ñāto hoti yasassī.
segments.mn113:7.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi ñāto yasassī, ime panaññe bhikkhū appaññātā appesakkhā’ti.
segments.mn113:7.4: So tena ñattena [ñātena (sī. ka.), ñātattena (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:7.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:7.7: ‘na kho ñattena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
segments.mn113:7.9: so ca hoti dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso’ti.
segments.mn113:7.10: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tena ñattena nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:8.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime panaññe bhikkhū na lābhino cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānan’ti.
segments.mn113:8.4: So tena lābhena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:8.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:8.7: ‘na kho lābhena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
segments.mn113:8.9: so ca hoti dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso’ti.
segments.mn113:8.10: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tena lābhena nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:9.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi bahussuto, ime panaññe bhikkhū na bahussutā’ti.
segments.mn113:9.4: So tena bāhusaccena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.

segments.mn113:9.7: ‘na kho bāhusaccena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

segments.mn113:9.10: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tena bāhusaccena nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:10.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi vinayadharo, ime panaññe bhikkhū na vinayadharā’ti.
segments.mn113:10.4: So tena vinayadharattena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.

segments.mn113:10.10: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tena vinayadharattena nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.

segments.mn113:12.4: So tena āraññikattena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.

segments.mn113:16-20.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sosāniko hoti … pe … abbhokāsiko hoti … nesajjiko hoti … yathāsanthatiko hoti … ekāsaniko hoti.
segments.mn113:16-20.7: ‘ahaṃ khomhi ekāsaniko, ime panaññe bhikkhū na ekāsanikā’ti.
segments.mn113:16-20.8: So tena ekāsanikattena attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:16-20.10: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:16-20.11: ‘na kho ekāsanikattena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
segments.mn113:16-20.13: so ca hoti dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso’ti.
segments.mn113:16-20.14: So paṭipadaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā tena ekāsanikattena nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:21.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn113:21.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime panaññe bhikkhū paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā na lābhino’ti.
segments.mn113:21.4: So tāya paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:21.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:21.8: Yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā’ti.
segments.mn113:21.9: So atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:22-24.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn113:22-24.5: ‘ahaṃ khomhi catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime panaññe bhikkhū catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā na lābhino’ti.
segments.mn113:22-24.6: So tāya catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:22-24.8: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:22-24.10: Yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā’ti.
segments.mn113:22-24.11: So atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:25.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn113:25.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime panaññe bhikkhū ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino’ti.
segments.mn113:25.4: So tāya ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:25.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:25.8: Yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā’ti.
segments.mn113:25.9: So atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:26.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan’ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn113:26.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime panaññe bhikkhū viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino’ti.
segments.mn113:26.4: So tāya viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:26.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:26.8: Yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā’ti.
segments.mn113:26.9: So atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:27.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn113:27.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime panaññe bhikkhū ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino’ti.
segments.mn113:27.4: So tāya ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:27.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:27.8: Yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā’ti.
segments.mn113:27.9: So atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:28.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn113:28.3: ‘ahaṃ khomhi nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime panaññe bhikkhū nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino’ti.
segments.mn113:28.4: So tāya nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:28.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.mn113:28.8: Yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā’ti.
segments.mn113:28.9: So atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā nevattānukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
segments.mn113:29.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sappuriso sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. Paññāya cassa disvā āsavā [ekacce āsavā (ka.)] parikkhīṇā honti.
segments.mn113:29.2: Ayaṃ [ayaṃ kho (syā. kaṃ.)], bhikkhave, bhikkhu na kiñci maññati, na kuhiñci maññati, na kenaci maññatī”ti.
segments.mn113:29.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Evaṃ mātikaṃ ṭhapetvāpi puna yathā nāma maggakusalo puriso vāmaṃ muñcitvā dakkhiṇaṃ gaṇhāti.
Paṭhamaṃ muñcitabbaṃ katheti, evaṃ pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭhamaṃ desento katamo ca, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammotiādimāha.
So tattha pujjoti so bhikkhu tesu bhikkhūsu pūjāraho.
Mahākulāti khattiyakulā vā brāhmaṇakulā vā vessakulā vā.
Yattha katthaci kule jāto hi puññabalehi mahābhogopi uḷārabhogopi hotiyeva.
Appaññātāti rattiṃ khittasarā viya saṅghamajjhādīsu na paññāyanti.
Imasmiñca sutte pāḷiyaṃ naveva dhutaṅgāni āgatāni, vitthārena panetāni terasa honti.
Tesu yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ sabbākārena visuddhimagge dhutaṅganiddese vuttameva.
Atammayataññeva antaraṃ karitvāti nittaṇhataṃyeva kāraṇaṃ katvā abbhantaraṃ vā katvā, citte uppādetvāti attho.
Nirodhavāre yasmā anāgāmikhīṇāsavāva taṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjanti, puthujjanassa sā natthi, tasmā asappurisavāro parihīno.
Na kañci maññatīti kañci puggalaṃ tīhi maññanāhi na maññati.
Na kuhiñci maññatīti kismiñci okāse na maññati.
Na kenaci maññatīti kenaci vatthunāpi taṃ puggalaṃ na maññati.
So pana yasmā sappurisānaṃ paveṇiko dhammo hoti.
Evaṃ padhānaṃ anuṭṭhātabbañca sappurisadhammaṃ ādiṃ katvā mātikaṃ ṭhapetvā ayathānupubbiyā niddisanto “katamo ca, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo”tiādimāha.
Tathā pana niddisanto udāharaṇapubbakaṃ hetuṃ dassetuṃ,“yathā nāmā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tena icchitabbapariccāgapubbakaṃ gahetabbaggahaṇaṃ nāma ñāyapaṭipatti, tasmā sappurisadhammā sampādetabbāti dīpento satthā ayathānupubbiyā niddhārīyatīti imamatthaṃ dasseti.
Tathā aññatthāpi “asevanā ca bālānaṃ, paṇḍitānañca sevanā”ti.
Tathāhi antimabhavikā bodhisattā tattheva paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhanti.
Paṭipadā hi viññūnaṃ pūjāya kāraṇaṃ, na uccakulīnatā.
Ādhipateyyābhāvato paresaṃ uparinatti etesaṃ īso īsanaṃ issariyanti akkhātabbāti appesakkhā.
Naveva dhutaṅgāni āgatānīti ettha yathā ukkaṭṭhapaṃsukūlikassa tecīvarikatā sukarā.
“paṃsukūliko hotī”tiādivacaneneva pāḷiyā anāgatānampi āgatabhāvo veditabbo pariharaṇasukaratāya tesampi samādānasambhavato.
Kāmataṇhādikāya tāya taṇhāya nibbattāti tammayā, puthujjanā, pakatibhāvūpagamanena tesaṃ bhāvo tammayatā, tappaṭikkhepato atammayatā, nittaṇhatā.
Taṃyeva kāraṇaṃ katvāti paṭhamajjhānepi taṇhāpahānaṃyeva kāraṇaṃ katvā.
Citte uppādetvāti atammayatāpariyāyena vutte taṇhāya paṭipakkhadhamme sampādetvā.
Na maññatīti maññanānaṃ ariyamaggena sabbaso samucchinnattā kismiñci okāse kāmabhavādike kenaci vatthunā hatthiassakhettavatthādinā pattacīvaravihārapariveṇādinā ca puggalaṃ na maññati.
